name: claude-bell
description: Chime in your VS Code window when Claude Code finishes its turn or waits for you. Self-contained: installs its own Claude Code hook. Sound plays on your machine even when Claude Code runs over SSH or in WSL.

commands.title: Claude Bell: Choose your own sound file
Claude Bell: Install hook into Claude Code
Claude Bell: Remove hook from Claude Code

claudeBell.enabled.description: Ring when Claude Code finishes its turn or waits for you.

claudeBell.sound.description: Which chime to play. Preview and pick in the Claude Bell panel.

claudeBell.soundFile.description: Your own .wav / .mp3 / .ogg to play when claudeBell.sound is "file". The file must live on the machine where Claude Code runs (over SSH: on the remote host). Pick it with “Choose file…” in the Claude Bell panel.

claudeBell.signalFile.description: Signal file the hook appends to. Empty means ~/.claude/.claude-bell-signal on the machine where Claude Code runs.

claudeBell.installHook.description: Install and keep Claude Bell's own hook in Claude Code's user settings (~/.claude/settings.json on the machine where Claude Code runs). Turn off if you manage Claude Code hooks yourself.
